description: Set the bio page order, either whole (link_ids top to bottom; links you leave out keep their order after these) or by moving one link (move: to top, bottom, after another link, or under a section title). A section title on the page (kind header) moves with every link under it, down to the next title, and lands only between sections: after or under_section puts it after the section that link is in, and top puts it after any links above the first title. Undo puts the old order back.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

move.description: Move one link instead of passing the whole order

to.description: top, bottom (the default), { after: link_id }, or { under_section: link_id of a section title } for right under that title

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: links_reorder
title: Reorder the bio page
